_comment: The layout: every path the enforcement layer names in a project, in one table (enforcement/README.md task E5.1). adopt.py, the three git hooks (through the layout.sh it writes into the state dir), claude-hook.py, the rendered settings file, the governing classes in paths.json and the jscpd ignore list all read it; nothing else names these paths. A value may name another key as {key}; {session_hook_dir} and {settings_local_file} are derived. The checks and the session hook live under the state dir, so a project has ONE folder that is the layer's and nothing can case-fold against a folder the project already has. A project overrides a key under "layout" in <state_dir>/config.json (adopt.py --checks-dir writes one) — every key but state_dir, which is the anchor the hooks find that file by. The env prefix names the variables the layer reads: <prefix>PLATFORM, <prefix>CHECKS_DIR, <prefix>STATE_DIR.
